## Objective
- Add a registration page before login that saves users to the database, redirects each role to its own pages, removes quick-access, and restricts all pages to Administrator-only.

## Requirements
- Registration options: **Almoxarifado**, **Administrador**, **Gestor**.
- Login must send users directly to the pages they use, with no quick-access option.
- Only Administrator may access all pages.
- Stop database errors and avoid daily manual user creation.

- Profiles reduced to `Administrador`, `Gestor`, `Almoxarifado`; legacy `Tecnico` normalized to `Almoxarifado`.
